hotel_1star_proxy.sourceTitle: How Much Do Hotels Cost in Mexico City? Hotel Prices for Mexico City, Mexico | Budget Your Trip

hotel_1star_proxy.referencePeriod: BudgetYourTrip hotel-price analysis; page crawled last month; prices are before taxes and vary seasonally.
